$comment: Reviewer -> driver. Written to .pipeline/plan-verdict.json on STEP=review-plan.

verdict.$comment: approved = hand to the coder; changes_requested = back to the architect with `questions`; escalate = the slice needs a human, the driver stops.

revision.$comment: The slice.json revision this verdict was formed against. The driver rejects a verdict for a stale revision.

why.$comment: What goes wrong during implementation if this stays unanswered. A question with no failure mode behind it is noise.
